description: This file contains utility functions and a React hook for handling booking success redirection, including URL parameter management, extracting booking details, and navigation logic within a booking application.

methods.name: getNewSearchParams
methods.description: Constructs a new URLSearchParams object by combining query parameters and existing search parameters, with optional filtering of internal parameters.

methods.name: getBookingRedirectExtraParams
methods.description: Extracts and compiles additional URL parameters from a booking object for redirection purposes, including attendee, host, and response details.

methods.name: useBookingSuccessRedirect
methods.description: A React hook that provides a function to handle redirection after a successful booking, managing URL parameters and navigation logic.
